1: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
2: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
3: And the LORD showed me four carpenters.
4: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spoke, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to frighten them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
5: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
6: Then said I, Where go you? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
7: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
8: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
9: For I, says the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
10: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, says the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, says the LORD.
11: Deliver yourself, O Zion, that dwell with the daughter of Babylon.
12: For thus says the LORD of hosts; After the glory has he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that touches you touches the apple of his eye.
13: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and all of you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me.
14: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you, says the LORD.
15: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of you, and you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me unto you.
16: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
17: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
